notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 notes
notes.content:
Addition of Guide Display Feature

A guide feature has been added that makes each type of object stand out until you collect the first one each time you play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271908/ff39c77fd8fa7e3cf55c7c82e401175352b7bff4.png

An option to disable this guide display feature has also been added to the settings.
Once you become familiar with the game, feel free to change the option and enjoy it your way.

Other updates

Text adjustments.
Fixed an issue where option changes might not be applied correctly.

notes.title: Updates to the FULL RELEASE version.
notes.content:
Update to the full release version is now available!

Currently, Early Access version price is still available.
The price will change to the full release version price after the launch sale ends.

The update will includes!

ENDLESS MODE

 In this newly added mode, players compete to see how far they can advance by avoiding randomly generated obstacles. You will also enjoy new music exclusively for this mode!


Visual updates and other adjustments

 We will be updating the visuals for several obstacles.
 Displays the remaining distance to the goal in each area.
 Make it easy to see the direction of attraction to gravity.
 Displays icons during special effects.
 The amount of energy recovery should also be indicated numerically.
 Add visual effects when using E-boost.
 The menu will glow when there are custom items available for purchase.
 Results will now show the difference when the ranking rises.
 New achievements will be added for the endless mode.
 Some other minor adjustments are being made.


We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: SPLASH OUT! is Steam Deck compatible.
notes.content:
SPLASH OUT! is Steam Deck compatible.

 All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration
 This game shows Steam Deck controller icons
 In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
 This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271908/8d8f7b62ada41b570610b32ebe0e5b24530afa7f.png

Enjoy SPLASH OUT! on Steam Deck!
